text.hero_title: Sensing the living signal state of the soil
text.hero_paragraph: Soil Genesis reads how living soil is functioning and helps restore it - how it's living state rests, changes, and recovers over time.
text.vision_h2_1: Nearly Everything We Eat Begins in the Soil
text.vision_h3_1: A Future Rooted in Living Soil
text.vision_p_2: Soil health shapes most life on land, which makes soil the highest-leverage place to strengthen everything downstream - the plants that feed us and the communities they sustain.
text.vision_p_3: Soil Genesis works toward that future by reading living function and supporting the structure and biology that allow soil to recover:
text.vision_li_1: Home gardeners produce abundant, healthy food
text.vision_li_2: Community gardens flourish with stronger local capacity
text.vision_li_3: Working farmland gain a regenerative advantage
text.vision_li_4: Degraded lands return to productive life
text.vision_li_5: Real-time signal layers for efficient supply chain management
text.vision_p_4: Where technology serves the soil, communities thrive.
text.journey_p_4: The platform begins from three practical observations:
text.journey_p_5: Fungal, microbial, root, water, and mineral processes operate as one changing system.
text.journey_p_6: Composition shows what is present. Function shows how the living system is behaving and changing.
text.journey_p_8: Response, stabilization, and recovery can reveal changes that a single static measurement may miss.
text.journey_p_10: Soil is alive, and its life reveals its state.
text.why-us_h2_1: One Connected Loop, Not a Single Device
text.why-us_p_1: Read the soil. Interpret its state. Restore structure and biology. Verify the change. Then read again, so every action teaches the next one.
text.why-us_p_2: Observe how living soil is functioning and changing over time.
text.why-us_p_3: Turn what we observe into a bounded picture of system state.
text.why-us_p_4: Support the structure and biology that allow soil to function.
text.why-us_p_5: Measure whether the system changed, recovered, or held its new state.
text.why-us_p_6: Use what the soil reveals to guide the next decision.
text.why-us_p_7: Separate measured evidence, interpretation, development targets, and what remains unvalidated.
text.why-us_p_8: The inventions are designed to strengthen one another across sensing, interpretation, restoration, delivery, and verification.
text.science_h2_1: A Portfolio Built as One System.
text.science_p_1: A portfolio organized by role within the same living-soil restoration loop.
text.science_p_5: Instruments and analytical layers for observing how living soil is functioning and how its state changes over time.
text.science_p_6: Tools for supporting structure and placing living biology where roots and fungi actually work.
text.science_p_7: Extensions of the same sensing and restoration logic across land, contamination, and field scale.
text.cascade_h2_1: The Cascade: From Soil to Flourishing
text.cascade_p_1: When we restore soil, we strengthen everything downstream.
text.cascade_p_2: This is not mystical thinking. It is documented ecology. Soil Genesis works at the foundation of a cascade that moves through ecosystems and communities.
text.cascade_p_8: Restore the foundation, and the benefits can move through the whole system.
text.soilbridge_subhead: Root-powered decompaction for no-till systems, measured by penetrometer resistance.
text.soilbridge_what_is_body: A microbial-coated cover-crop seed blend designed to rebuild compacted subsoil into persistent vertical channels that future crop roots can follow, without mechanical disturbance.
text.soilbridge_primary_outcome: 20-30% reduction in penetrometer resistance at 12-18 inch depth, treatment compared with compacted control, subject to field validation.
text.soilbridge_p_3: Long-term no-till operators who already measure compaction, especially in heavy clay and silt loam soils.
text.solutions_p: A business model designed to make the science durable and self-sustaining.
text.solutions_sb_p: Season-long soil work to develop fungal and microbial inoculants matched to a grower's fields, beginning with specialty crops.
text.solutions_sb_b2: A service pathway that can generate revenue.
text.solutions_sb_b3: Real projects that create comparable evidence.
text.solutions_gc_p: Where Soil Genesis technologies are tested, refined, and validated under real conditions.
text.solutions_ss_p: Signals paired with real outcomes, creating a proprietary dataset that sharpens the tools over time.
text.solutions_ss_b1: Observations linked to treatment and recovery.
text.solutions_ss_b2: Comparable records across projects and conditions.
text.solutions_ss_b3: A compounding asset built through actual work.
text.about_p_1: The interest is arriving, and the foundation is set.
text.about_h3_1: Early, Building, and Explicit About What Remains
text.about_p_3: A National Science Foundation program director invited Soil Genesis to submit a full federal funding proposal. The invention portfolio has undergone strategic review with experienced patent counsel.
text.about_p_4: The next precision sensing core is being built and tested against the validated field-response platform, while comparative validation protocols continue to mature.
text.about_p_6: Direct NSF invitation to submit a full proposal.
text.about_p_7: Full invention portfolio strategically reviewed with experienced patent counsel.
text.about_p_8: Next-generation sensing hardware in active build and test.
text.about_p_9: Testing moving toward controlled comparative validation.
text.about_p_11: Living-soil intelligence and restoration platform - validation and engineering underway.

text.cta_p_2: This is an invitation to help build the next layer of living-soil intelligence and practical restoration.

html.global_h1_1: Listening to what the soil has been trying to sayRead. Restore. Verify.
html.journey_p_2: We did not set out to build a product. We set out to listen.
html.journey_p_3: Soil is not an inert medium. It is a living system whose fungal, microbial, root, water, and mineral processes shape nutrient cycling, structure, resilience, and recovery. That living activity reveals how the system is functioning over time.
html.journey_p_9: The goal is not to force a story onto soil. It is to build disciplined ways of observing what the living system reveals.
html.global_p_1: “Soil is alive, and its life reveals its state.”
html.cascade_p_3: Living fungal and microbial networks support nutrient cycling, aggregation, water movement, and resilience. This is the foundation everything else rests on.
html.cascade_p_4: Healthier soil can support stronger roots, improved nutrient access, and crops that are better equipped to withstand stress.
html.cascade_p_5: Healthier plants support insects, pollinators, birds, and wildlife. Restore soil function, and you strengthen the web of life above it.
html.cascade_p_6: More resilient local food systems can support access to healthy food and reconnect people with the biological foundation of nourishment.
html.cascade_p_7: Stronger local food security, greater ecological resilience, and deeper community connection around shared food production.
html.cascade_p_9: Ecologists describe cascades in which change at one level moves through the larger system. Soil restoration can become the beginning of a positive cascade - provided each downstream claim is tested at the level where it is made.
html.cascade_p_10: The Soil Genesis position: begin at the foundation, measure honestly, and build restoration systems whose effects can be observed rather than assumed.
html.soilbridge_p_1: Target field outcome: 20-30% reduction in penetrometer resistance at 12-18 inch depth, treatment compared with compacted control, subject to field validation.
html.soilbridge_p_2: Development boundary: structural soil restoration only. No pesticidal, disease-control, or guaranteed-yield claims.
html.soilbridge_li_1: Biological action: deep-rooting cover crops form channels through compacted layers under favorable conditions.
html.soilbridge_li_2: Biological support: a microbial seed coating supports root establishment and channel development.
html.soilbridge_li_3: Persistent structure: decomposing roots leave pathways later crop roots can follow.
html.soilbridge_li_4: Core treatment: seed blend and biological coating configured for field testing.
html.soilbridge_li_5: Verification: treatment-versus-control penetrometer measurements at target depth.
html.about_p_2: Soil Genesis is moving through outside review, federal funding pathways, hardware development, and structured validation.
html.about_p_5: The company is early, but the work is no longer only conceptual. The hard parts are named rather than hidden.
